lines.2: She crawled under the desk to plug in the cord.
lines.3: That left her rear sticking out toward me.
lines.4: Combined with her short pants, it left a lot of pale skin exposed.
lines.5: She had a healthy kind of allure.
lines.6: I hated myself for being conscious of her over something like this.
lines.7: 「Tch. It is dirty around this outlet. Bring me a dry cloth.」
lines.9: 「There are small patches of dirt here and there.」
lines.10: Her body moved as she wiped them clean.
lines.11: So did the rear pointed in my direction.
lines.12: This was what they meant by a sight too tempting to look at.
lines.13: She had a charm that made it impossible not to be aware of her.
lines.14: Maybe it was because her figure was so graceful.
lines.15: 「Hey. What are you doing? If you are going to help, then help properly.」
